thread.title: Energy Recap: Apple Launches Clean Energy Fund In China - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: SA Editor Michelle Carini
title: Energy Recap: Apple Launches Clean Energy Fund In China - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Welcome to the latest edition of the Energy Recap. This week, Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) announced that it has launched a clean energy fund in China, its latest renewable energy project. According to The Verge , the company "will work with 10 other suppliers to jointly invest $300 million over the next four years. The end result is what Apple calling the China Clean Energy Fund, which will 'invest in and develop clean energy projects' that total more than 1 gigawatt of renewable energy in the country. That's enough to power 1 million homes, according to the company. A third party, DWS Group, will manage the funds and invest."
While this is an interesting step forward, it's important to note that smaller companies can still find it difficult to transition away from traditional energy sources and toward renewable energy. So, what are your thoughts about Apple's announcement? Do you think it will have a significant impact going forward? Please leave us your thoughts on this or anything else energy related in the comments section below.
